messages:
maria_ae: Quick help — HeliosHealth wants a 6-week POC on a private (VPC) deployment. Procurement is asking for 40% off list for the pilot and says it will convert to a 12mo commit if successful. Can we do 40% for the POC?

devon_se: How many tokens / what's the workload mix? Private = infra + setup. Need numbers to check unit economics.

maria_ae: Rough estimate: ~1.5B tokens over 6 weeks, mix is ~70% generation, 30% embeddings/rerank. They want Private (VPC) + KMS. Sales thinks conversion probability ~70%.

june_dealdesk: FYI — per deal desk policy anything >30% discount needs director sign-off. Also need ACV and minimum committed $ amount for the conversion. Can we get a target annual commit?

sanjay_finance: If it's private with KMS and dedicated infra, 40% off likely breaks margin unless we get a sizable commit. With 30–35% + a $200–300k ARR commit it's more palatable. Need exact model selection to run the math.

olivia_se: Heads up: KMS + SOC2 + on-prem audit adds non-trivial setup hours. Recommend offering 35% max for the POC and require a $300k annual commitment to justify the private setup, or we convert to hosted with lower infra cost.

maria_ae: Customer is pushing back on $300k — they say their procurement ceiling is ~$180k/yr. They can sign 12mo at that level but want the 40% pilot discount as part of the negotiation. Any levers?

june_dealdesk: Proposal for approval flow: approve 35% POC discount conditional on (1) signed 12mo at $180k ARR, (2) refundable $25k setup fee applied as credit on conversion, and (3) explicit data residency/KMS addendum. Anything above 35% requires director sign-off. I'll route to director if team agrees.

anna_head_sales: :thumbsup: I support the conditional 35% approach. We need the refundable setup fee to protect margin and the commit to be explicit in the SOW. Legal should confirm the addendum language.

approvals-bot: Approval request submitted to Director (ticket SR-2026-178). Routing for final sign-off.

devon_se: I'll scope the infra and add a line-item estimate into the deal doc today. Will also note migration/ops hours for the KMS work.

legal: We'll need the customer's security questionnaire and standard T&Cs before we sign. Also need to review indemnity and export control clauses for the private deploy. Please attach their SQ.

maria_ae: I'll collect the SQ and push the redline. POC target start 2026-04-15, so we need final sign-off by 2026-04-01 to hit dates. Thanks all — routing now to June for director path.
